====

WHAT YOU WILL LEARN
----
• Say what understanding ufahamu wa kusikiliza means in plain words.
• Give one Kenyan example linked to Ufahamu wa Kusikiliza.
• Correct one common mistake about this page.

INTRODUCTION
----
Begin with something you can point to at a kitchen in Kisumu. On “Understanding Ufahamu wa Kusikiliza”, how would you explain ufahamu wa kusikiliza to a classmate in one minute? • Ujuzi wa kidijitali: mwanafunzi anapotumia vifaa vya kidijitali kusikiliza matini ya ufahamu.
